messages:
jamie: Heads up - eu-west1 warm pool started refusing to release GPU leases after scale-down last hour, causing ~40 pending pods and ~15 preempts. seeing a lot of packing failures and repeated binpack churn.
cristina: saw the same. lease-controller shows repeated 504s to allocation service around 16:02 UTC. saving logs to /tmp/leases-504.log.
jamie: paste from leases-504.log: ```[2024-04-15T16:02:12Z] lease-refresh failed status=504 id=gp-pool-3 err=\"upstream timeout\"
[2024-04-15T16:02:13Z] lease-refresh failed status=504 id=gp-pool-3 err=\"upstream timeout\"```
ops-bot: autoscaler: scale-up x3 triggered for warmpool-eu-west at 16:03 (reason: pending pods > threshold) :warning:
mike: are the pending pods tiny-gpu or gang-sized?
jamie: mix. majority tiny (0.25 GPU) but a few 4x-GPU training jobs couldn't place due to taint+affinity. fragmentation exacerbated by nodes being marked "allocated" but not actually schedulable.
cristina: hypothesize: lease refresh stalled -> nodes remain in allocated state -> scheduler treats them as available capacity for some predicate checks but kubelet not ready -> scheduler can't consolidate -> leads to backpressure and autoscaler over-reacting.
jamie: quick workaround: evacuating one warmpool rack and setting warmpool.min=0 for eu-west1 for 10m to let scheduler rebalance. kicking that now.
mike: cost note - extra spinups escalate cost. rough calc: if sustained scale it's ~5k/hr.
jamie: agree, but short-lived spinups cheaper than continued preempts and failed jobs.
cristina: pushed a small canary to lease-proxy to add 5s retry jitter and earlier fail-fast; rolling to eu-west canary-2. also added logging to surface upstream timeouts. @sre-oncall please monitor preempt and lease-proxy 5xx.
sre-oncall: watching. alert rules: preempt_rate > 5/min, lease-proxy 5xx > 1%. I'll post updates.
mike: also propose a scheduler predicate to treat nodes with outstanding lease-refresh > 30s as unschedulable to avoid false capacity signals. small PR ready (PR#482) for review.
jamie: +1. that predicate will reduce fake capacity and limit binpack fragmentation. please include unit test for lease-timestamp boundary.
sre-oncall: alert - preempt_count spiked to 9 at 16:07, but dropped after evac steps. ops-bot reports 2 nodes drained and 3 new nodes joined fully ready.
cristina: postmortem TODOs: root cause = lease-controller <-> allocation upstream timeouts under transient load. mitigation = lease retry/backoff + autoscaler backpressure, scheduler predicate + warmpool lifecycle reconciliation. long-term: move lease-refresh to a mesh with backpressure signals and add eviction tolerations for tiny-gpu to reduce churn.
jamie: action list: 1) hotfix lease-retry (cristina) 2) scheduler predicate roll (mike) 3) warmpool min toggle documented and automated (jamie) 4) follow-up infra design doc (teams).
mike: I'll own PR#482 and run the canary once landed.
jamie: thanks all. will close when metrics stable for 30m.
cristina: adding a short runbook note in runbooks/warmpool-lease.md with steps to toggle min and force reconcile.
sre-oncall: confirming metrics: lease-proxy 5xx dropped to 0.3%, preempts < 1/min. continuing watch. :thumbsup:
